## #26120 landed: 16 open ui PRs unblocked

#26120 (Fixes #26051) merged at 13:49Z as `a335f1de`. It replaces the single global registry digest in `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` with one one-line record per ui registry package under `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/`.

**Open ui PRs it unblocks: 16.** These are all the open PRs that re-record the registry, read against main `a335f1de`. Each row lists the reached packages whose non-test `src/` the PR changes. None of the 16 changes `sdui.manifest.json` itself.

| PR | registry packages |
|:--|:--|
| #26123 | i18n |
| #26062 | fields |
| #26060 | plugin-detail, react |
| #26055 | i18n, plugin-detail, types |
| #26053 | plugin-detail, react |
| #26050 | fields, plugin-grid |
| #26048 | i18n, plugin-map |
| #26045 | i18n |
| #26044 | i18n |
| #26042 | plugin-form |
| #26040 | components, i18n |
| #26033 | core, plugin-form, plugin-grid |
| #26030 | plugin-grid |
| #26027 | plugin-dashboard |
| #26011 | core, types |
| #25998 | plugin-detail |

Eight of them are the ui PRs dequeued earlier on this card: #26027 #26030 #26033 #26042 #26044 #26048 #26050 #26062.

**Before:** all 16 conflicted pairwise on one line. They could land only one at a time, and every landing made the other 15 re-merge and regenerate.

**Now:** each PR conflicts once on `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`, because it still carries the old layout. It clears that once:

```sh
git merge origin/main
git checkout --theirs scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json
node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs
git add scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json scripts/sdui-manifest.sources sdui.manifest.json
git commit
```

After that, two PRs conflict only when they touch the same package. The largest group is `i18n`, with 6 PRs (#26123 #26055 #26048 #26045 #26044 #26040). So the 16 can land in **6 rounds instead of 16**. For example, with no package shared inside a round:

1. #26123, #26062, #26060, #26042, #26030, #26027, #26011 (7 together)
2. #26055, #26050
3. #26048, #26053, #26033
4. #26045, #25998
5. #26044
6. #26040

This assumes no source-level conflicts between them. A PR that changes `sdui.manifest.json` would still re-record all 27 packages and conflict with every in-flight registry PR, as before.

The maintainer accepted the stated residual: two PRs on different packages are no longer forced to regenerate together. The structural follow-up, where CI regenerates and compares so the queue checks the combination, is #26137.
